# Domain — Holiday cabin rentals (made-up fixture)

## 1. Domain overview
Small owners rent out one or two cabins each, usually through several listing sites at once.
Guests are mostly groups (4–8 people) booking 2–7 nights, planned weeks ahead.

## 2. Core processes
Guests agree dates in a group chat, compare a handful of cabins, one person books and pays,
then collects money from the others. Owners copy bookings between listing sites by hand.

## 4. Roles & responsibilities
- **Group organiser** — finds and books the cabin for the group, pays up front.
- **Guest** — joins a booking someone else made.
- **Small owner** — lists 1–2 cabins alongside a day job; manages calendars and messages.

## 6. Current challenges
- Listings show "sleeps 8" without saying whether beds are real beds or sofa beds; groups
  find out on arrival.
- Owners with more than one listing site get double bookings when a calendar isn't updated.
- Organisers chase friends for their share of the money for weeks afterwards.
